items.title: Validate the token-cost audit document as an executable implementation source
items.context: Confirm current code still matches the document claims before coding: agent template snapshot sizes, signature domains, prompt registry/global-thin support, and story_get/checklist_get duplication. Treat prompt-cache billing uncertainty as a measurement caveat, not a blocker.

happy.desc: A mechanical audit check reports current template snapshot sizes and confirms the audit document remains executable against current source paths.

edge.desc: The audit evidence reports prompt-cache billing uncertainty as a caveat rather than an exact cost-saving claim.

adversarial.desc: If a cited implementation path drifts, the verification must fail or report the drift instead of silently treating the audit as executable.

items.title: Replace repeated full agent prompt snapshots with registry-generated load-bearing prompt slices
items.context: Use prompt-registry/managed-assets patterns instead of hand-maintained prompt copies. Preserve fresh-context fence text and flow-fact/process-gate semantics required by init/scope/review/delivery gates. Do not weaken reviewer independence or signed artifact validation.

happy.desc: Affected package and project agent prompts no longer carry repeated full 50KB+ guide snapshots and instead retain compact load-bearing guidance.

edge.desc: Fresh-context fence, review-run/finding/pass flow facts, and lifecycle safety instructions remain present after slimming.

adversarial.desc: Prompt slimming must not change Authority Server receipt claims, handoff authority boundaries, reviewer independence, or signed artifact validation semantics.

items.title: Add additive slim read output for high-frequency story inspection commands
items.context: Add default-preserving slim/fields behavior for story_get and checklist_get only if it does not alter existing callers. This is a low-risk token reduction and must remain opt-in.

happy.desc: story_get/checklist_get provide explicit opt-in slim output that removes repeated heavy payload while preserving enough status information for quick inspection.

edge.desc: Default story_get and checklist_get output remains byte-shape compatible for existing callers unless slim/fields is requested.

adversarial.desc: Slim output must not hide lifecycle-blocking facts such as phase, checklist status counts, init fallback, review status, or required reviewer evidence when those facts are requested.

items.title: Add regression checks for prompt-safety and token-reduction invariants
items.context: Tests must prove load-bearing prompt sections remain present, default command output remains backward compatible, slim output reduces repeated payload, and managed assets/process facts do not drift.

items.title: Run full Lattice review and delivery closure without Authority overclaim
items.context: Validate through Lattice lifecycle with concept/quality/test-coverage/docs/delivery reviewers as required. This story may produce local Non-authority evidence only; Authority Server receipt-backed claims remain out of scope.
